ask: Chris 2026-11-21T02:01Z: 'Test ina. Variety if models and architectures', in reply to 'still only tested on GPT-2 small, with no KV cache'.
reachable: huggingface.co, GitHub release pages, Ollama, Kaggle and ModelScope are not reachable from this session; the Hugging Face connector reads text files only. Reachable model sources: the onnx/models zoo's LFS files (GPT-2 small LM head, T5-base encoder and decoder with LM head) and Google's own t5-data bucket (the T5 SentencePiece vocabulary). No mirror of Hugging Face is used.

models.gpt2-fp32-ort: GPT-2 small LM head ONNX, onnxruntime CPU, the pinned file of log record 0 (baseline, rerun on this contract)
models.gpt2-int8-ort: the same file dynamically quantized to int8 weights here with onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic (QInt8); sha256 logged
models.gpt2-numpy-kv: the same GPT-2 weights read from the ONNX initializers, run by a numpy float32 forward with a KV cache (a different runtime and a cached decode path)
models.t5-base-ort: T5-base encoder and decoder-with-LM-head ONNX from the zoo (encoder-decoder, relative position bias, SentencePiece vocabulary 32,128); prompt = the T1 prompt text plus the sentinel <extra_id_0>, decoder starts from pad id 0
models.llama-style-random: MECHANICS ONLY: numpy decoder with RoPE, grouped-query attention (8 query heads, 2 KV heads), RMSNorm, SwiGLU, KV cache; d 256, 4 layers, random weights from seed 0, GPT-2 vocabulary size
models.mamba-style-random: MECHANICS ONLY: numpy selective state-space model (input-dependent step, B, C; diagonal A; depthwise causal conv 4; state 16; expansion 2), recurrent constant-size state as its cache; d 256, 4 layers, random weights from seed 0, GPT-2 vocabulary size

mechanics_only_means: random weights test that the rule, the replay, the cache and the skipping machinery are exact on that architecture; they say nothing about quality, so no task win or loss is claimed for them
histories: the 35 T1 TEST prompts in order (GPT-2 token ids; for T5 their decoded text re-encoded with SentencePiece); 24 generated tokens or the model's own end token
rule: prlm-0 (certified best-first over round(256*logit), weights 0); replay change = rep 1.5, noloop 4 (the declared prlm-theta weights), both vocabulary-independent axes

measures.E1_repeat: first 8 histories: per-step logits computed twice in one process (cache off) and in a fresh process with 1 thread vs 4 threads; count bitwise-equal rows, equal integer-score rows, equal picks
measures.E2_lean: Lean executable on each model's replay: agree, agreeRe, reEqRec, sparseEq must equal steps; also certified count and sparse work
measures.E3_batch_or_cache: per-step logits vs logits from one forward over the final sequence (all positions), and for KV models cached decode vs full recompute: bitwise rows, integer-score rows, picks
measures.E4_skip: verified drafting from the current history's own prompt and generated tokens (skip2 'ctx' index) vs the clean replay: reply mismatches, picks and margins mismatches, model calls
measures.E5_drift: gpt2-int8-ort and gpt2-numpy-kv vs gpt2-fp32-ort, teacher-forced on the fp32 trajectories: pick agreement, integer-score agreement, certified-flag agreement; and generated-sequence equality
measures.E6_tasks: run.py's T3 (ban, topic, end) on gpt2-int8-ort with the model swapped; other models UNMEASURED for tasks (different tokenizer or no meaningful weights)

controls.do-nothing: empty draft index must equal the clean replay with the same calls
controls.gamed: draft = the clean replay's own continuation (reads the answer), labelled GAMED, ceiling only
controls.self: fp32 vs fp32 drift must be 100%
controls.tamper: a replay file with one pick changed must make the Lean executable exit 1

verdict_rule: a property holds for a model only with 0 mismatches on every history; every mismatch is listed; architectures not run (Llama, Qwen or Mistral weights, Mamba or RWKV weights, any model above 220M parameters, GPU kernels, a KV-cached ONNX export) are UNMEASURED
